task_desc: Hook integration experiment in a brownfield project. When adding a guard hook to an existing codebase, existing tests must not break. Regression test coverage must be >= 90%.
Multi-agent sprint management experiment. While 3 agents work in the same sprint, status updates in sprint-status.yaml must happen without race conditions. Concurrent write test.
End-to-end experiment loop experiment. Run the Theory → Hypothesis → Experiment → Measurement → Gate → Code → Commit → Memory loop end to end in one pass. Perform quality checks at each step.
Performance benchmark experiment. Measure how much the guard hook delays file writes in a project with 1000 files. p95 latency must be < 100ms.
